howToPlay: Maintain distance and use your poison to prevent enemies from healing and deal damage over time. Use your Super to jump into combat for finishes or to escape dangerous situations. Manage your poison carefully to weaken enemies with Extra Toxic or deal extra damage to low health targets with Carrion Crow.
gears: Use DAMAGE to finish off targets when your health is low, or choose SHIELD to increase your survivability. ENDURING TOXINS is highly recommended to extend the duration of your debilitating poison effects.
trait: This assassin is ideal for players who prefer a hit-and-run playstyle focused on constant harassment and tactical positioning.
